recommendation: Option A. The single authorized correction changes only a test-local collection annotation and now gives focused H4 source-and-test mypy PASS across 16 files without changing values, assertions, public contract, behavior, or evidence meaning. R2 was replayed exactly once in an isolated worktree and retains eight PASS pairs: four equivalent, four cited intentional, zero defects, and zero deferred. E2 references R2 without equating them. Focused tests and Ruff pass; H4 introduced zero logical Ruff findings relative to its starting revision and removed one finding. Targeted integration confirmation and H4 completion pass. Repository-wide Ruff retains 43 findings and global mypy retains nine pre-existing H2 errors, both explicitly limited to baseline debt. Legacy remains authoritative pending this decision.
